summary: Computes an interpolated along-track distance for the current position relative to a track segment, with lap-wraparound correction of the three waypoint distances based on a session state flag. Reads the position monitor via PositionChangeMonitor, obtains two waypoint objects and a stored session flag, projects the current position (this+0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC) onto the segment between the waypoints, and interpolates the stored per-waypoint distances by the clamped projection factor. Returns one of the stored distances or an interpolated blend depending on where the projection falls; returns the first waypoint distance when the segment length is zero.

operations.description: Call PositionChangeMonitor(this) to obtain the position monitor object v2 used for waypoint pointers and stored distances.
Load the session state flag from the object referenced by this, at offset 0x4040 (16448), into v3.
Read the three stored along-track distances: one from v2, and one from each of the two waypoint objects obtained from v2; seed v15, result, and v16.
Branch on the session state flag v3: state 0 and state 2 select different lap-wraparound correction directions for each of the three distances.
For each of the three tracked objects, adjust its stored distance by flt_5EA408: add it when the per-object state is 0 under flag 2, subtract it when the per-object state is 2 under flag 0.
Form the segment vector as the difference between the two waypoint positions (each read as x/y/z at offsets 0/4/8).
Compute the segment length via sqrt of the squared components; if the length is zero, return the first stored distance v15.

Normalize the segment direction by 1/length, then project the monitor-relative position and the current position (this+0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC) onto that direction to produce the projection scalars v19 and v17.

Classify the projection v17: beyond the segment end returns the third distance v16, inside the segment interpolates between v15 and v16 by the projection ratio, before the start blends between result and v15.
Return the selected or interpolated distance; when the projection is not positive, return the second stored distance (result).
